About

Andnet DeBoer earned dual degrees in Electrical Engineering (B.S.) and Computer Science (B.A.) with a minor in Mathematics from Hope College. He began exploring robotics at a young age, programming his first LEGO robot at nine and participating in four years of FIRST Robotics. As an undergraduate, he worked on projects from multi-agent robotic systems to a self-playing bass guitar combining hardware and software design.

His research interests include mobile manipulation, robot motion planning, and simulation, with an emphasis on building robotic systems that are safe and effective in dynamic environments.
